استئيسوا (form X)
# اُسْتُئِيسُوا (ustuʔīsū) /us.tu.ʔiː.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَآسَ (istaʔāsa)
# اِسْتَئِيسُوا (istaʔīsū) /is.ta.ʔiː.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَآسَ (istaʔāsa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
